body.name: Graph and sparse-polynomial bit model
body.construction: Encode \(p\) and \(q\) in binary, encode \(G\) and \(G'\) by their \(q\times q\) adjacency bit matrices in the common topological order, and encode every denominator-cleared input branch polynomial sparsely by binary exponent vectors and signed binary integer coefficients. The encoding lists every chart denominator, denominator-clearing inequation, variance-positivity polynomial, covariance-cone minor, exact-support and retained-edge residual, mixing nonzero and noncollinearity factor, and theorem-specific exceptional factor, together with sparse degree and coefficient height. Let \(B=|\operatorname{Enc}(p,G,G')|_{\mathrm{bit}}\) be this pre-solution input length; certificate coefficient growth is part of the output complexity to be bounded.
